findings.title: Justice as load-bearing balance

findings.reader_payoff: Justice becomes perceptible as an ongoing act of carrying and rebalancing under emotional and relational pressure.
findings.containment: The balance image deepens the command to act justly and does not replace its ordinary legal and moral force; it does not claim that qist is only a literal instrument or that every pressure has equal weight.

epistemic.reason: The cross-run source is trusted and gives exact focus anchors; the branch facets are registered as accepted, with the supplied connection used as a supporting parallel.
